title: Co-Founder & CEO
bullets: Built and led a 15-member cross-functional startup, launched a flagship product that rapidly scaled to 1M users in month one.

bullets.text: Secured a $1M investment in 2015 and scaled a high-traffic consumer product from the ground up.
